title: Published system tensor comparison respects composition
statement: On the actual unbounded semilinear sequence category, the published pullbackTensorSystemComparison respects every section-normalized Compositors presentation, with exactly SystemTensorComposition. [def-sf-ambient-proper-open-calculus]

source.place: Tags 0F7B--0F7D; sites-modules.tex Tags 03D3 and 03EL; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 07A4 and 07A7.

proof.text: Use the actual ambient sequence-site data recorded in publishedSystemAmbientData. Identify each published tensor comparison with its ambient comparison using the single-morphism comparison-identification theorem, and identify the section-normalized compositor with the inverse ambient compositor. These are separate tensor and compositor identifications.

Use the proved native sequence-category specialization publishedSystemAmbientCoherence. Its proof derives the characteristic inequality from the finite-field cardinality and specializes the final ambient tensor-composition equation to the actual systemClosed structures and systemTensorModel models.

Apply transfer_tensor_composition: naturality and the three single-morphism comparison squares give the square for the composite functor isomorphism. Postcompose with the tensor square of the invertible ambient compositor, use its identification and ambient coherence, and cancel. This proves the published equation for arbitrary unbounded sequence objects.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4 and 07A7: representative comparison, adjunction compositor, and naturality/cancellation. U2 makes the two presentation identifications explicit.
